entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-07-02
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Additional ProjectReference if the referenced project has an ampersand in its path #49632
  • dotnet pack fails with "Duplicate 'PackageDownload' items found" when using EnablePackageValidation with PackageValidationBaselineVersion #49631
  • With .NET SDK 10.0 P7, the Aspire workload manifest is available and Aspire 8 workload can be installed #49629

Closed

  • SDK should disable default item globbing when asking MSBuild to perform implicit Restores #49415
  • Multi-RID packages should strip all package types except `DotnetToolRidPackage` from the 'inner' packages #49615
    10.0.1xx

PullRequests

Created

  • reduce allocations in GenerateDepsFile #49638
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Fix source build #49637
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Draft #49636
  • Implement `#:package` manipulation for file-based apps #49635
    Area-run-file
  • Fix forwarding DOTNET_ROOT #49634
  • Improve handling of CTRL+C when dnx is used on Windows #49633

Merged

  • Revert "Explicitly enable BF for WinForms and WPF in Microsoft.NET.Sdk.targets" #49562
    Area-NetSDK
  • use the sdk.paths mechanism from .NET 10p3 #49627
  • Improve MSBuild argument parsing and tracking, and use that to set RestoreProperties that optimize Restore for large projects #49526
    Area-CLI
  • Consume shared components from external URI in non-1xx feature band #49607
    Area-Infrastructure
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #49628
    Area-CodeFlow
  • [automated] Update man pages #49612
  • Strip all package types from inner multi-rid tool packages so they don't appear on search-based experiences #49616

Updated

  • Use ProjectGraph for DTB #49589
    Area-Watch
  • Include some default items in file-based apps #49584
    Area-run-file
  • Skip MSBuild and call only CSC for simple file-based apps #49528
    Area-run-file, 10.0.1xx
  • Add 'RunCsWinRTGenerator' task and target #49417
  • [WIP] [do not review] enable containerd tests #49617
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Adjust `IsTestProject` hacks to not include MTP #49085
